scripts.test: pnpm run build && tsx --test tests/*.test.mjs tests/*.test.ts
scripts.check: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run lint && pnpm run test && pnpm run test:browser
scripts.db:migrate:local: WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=.wrangler/wrangler.log wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local
scripts.db:migrate:remote: WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=.wrangler/wrangler.log wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote
scripts.deploy: pnpm run build && pnpm run db:migrate:remote && WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=.wrangler/wrangler.log wrangler deploy
scripts.deploy:dry: pnpm run build && WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=.wrangler/wrangler.log wrangler deploy --dry-run

CALOCOUNT_SETUP_CODE.description: A long phrase that only you know, with **at least 12 characters**. On your first visit you type it to save your first passkey. Keep it safe: it also adds a new passkey if you lose your devices.

CALOCOUNT_OWNER_KEY.description: Keep `default`. It is the key of your data in the database.

CALOCOUNT_ALLOW_LOCAL.description: Keep `false`. The value `true` turns off sign-in and is **only for local development**.
